subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should Discord component clicks expose a new agent-visible structured interaction metadata envelope, and which fields should be public versus plugin-only?
rationale: This changes the public agent inbound context and exposes Discord identifiers, so maintainers need to choose the schema, trust boundary, and compatibility shape before implementation.

options.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
options.body: Expose a narrow documented metadata envelope with message id, action kind, safe custom/callback data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

options.title: Keep Metadata Plugin-Only
options.body: Leave rich interaction fields in the plugin interactive-handler API and document that stateful Discord workflows should use plugin callbacks rather than generic agent fallback messages.

options.title: Narrow To Sender/Message Only
options.body: Expose only clicker and originating message ids first, deferring custom id/callback payload semantics until the broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow documented metadata envelope with message id, action kind, safe custom/callback data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the public agent/channel contract, and @steipete has the strongest verified recent routing through plugin-boundary and Discord review history among the owner candidates.
